title: Ethical Dilemma Experiences of School Principals: A Phenomenological Approach
text_snippet: Ethical Dilemma Experiences of School Principals: A Phenomenological Approach This study aims to thoroughly examine the ethical dilemmas experienced by school principals in their professional practices across cognitive, affective, and behavioral dimensions from a phenomenological perspective. Designed within a qualitative research approach, the study involved semi-structured interviews with 21 school principals selected through maximum variation and criterion sampling techniques. During the analysis process, a systematic path appropriate for descriptive phenomenological data was followed, aiming to reach the shared meaning structures distilled from the participants' experiences. The findings revealed that school principals experienced ethical dilemmas beyond mere rational reasoning, as a multi-layered process where emotional toll, social pressure, and professional responsibilities intersect. It was observed that internal tensions and stakeholder conflicts were prominent in this process, and resolution strategies varied between legal-principled approaches and value-oriented or experiential preferences. title: A Bibliometric Analysis of Global Research on Universities of the Third Age and Older Adult Education (1982–2025)
text_snippet: A Bibliometric Analysis of Global Research on Universities of the Third Age and Older Adult Education (1982–2025) This study examines global publication trends and the intellectual structure of research on Universities of the Third Age (U3A) and later-life learning through bibliometric analysis. Data were retrieved from the Web of Science Core Collection on November 9, 2025, using the keywords “University of the Third Age”, “Third Age University”, “Third Age learning”, “learning in later life”, “education for older adults”, and “elderly education”, yielding 530 documents. These were subjected to co-authorship, citation, keyword co-occurrence, and bibliographic coupling analyses via VOSviewer. Findings reveal an acceleration in publication volume post-2010, predominantly comprising articles (75%). Poland (99 publications), the USA (65), and China (47) are the most productive countries, whereas Malta (TLS=71) serves as the strategic hub due to high link strength. At the institutional level, the University of Malta (TLS=99) and Nicolaus Copernicus University (TLS=38) act as intellectual bridges, with Marvin Formosa (TLS=142) emerging as the key theoretical leader. title: School Motivation and Teachers’ Ethical Behaviors: The Mediating Role of Quality of School Life
text_snippet: School Motivation and Teachers’ Ethical Behaviors: The Mediating Role of Quality of School Life This study examined the structural relationships among students’ school motivation, perceived ethical behaviors of teachers, and the quality of school life related to school management. The study further investigated the mediating role of school life quality in the relationship between teachers’ ethical behaviors and student motivation. The research was conducted using a quantitative survey design with a sample of 403 secondary school students attending public schools in Denizli, Türkiye. Data were analyzed using Structural Equation Modeling (SEM). The findings revealed that perceived ethical behaviors of teachers positively predicted both students’ quality of school life and their school motivation. In addition, quality of school life was found to be a significant predictor of school motivation. The results also indicated that quality of school life related to school management played a partial mediating role in the relationship between teachers’ ethical behaviors and student motivation. title: Instructional Practices in Turkish Kindergarten Classrooms: An Exploratory Study of Opportunities to Respond and Teacher Feedback
text_snippet: Instructional Practices in Turkish Kindergarten Classrooms: An Exploratory Study of Opportunities to Respond and Teacher Feedback Evidence from unstructured observations, teacher interviews, and standardized assessments such as the Early Childhood Environment Rating Scale (ECERS) and the Classroom Assessment Scoring System (CLASS) indicates that early childhood classrooms in Türkiye often struggle with the quality and frequency of teacher-child interactions and the efficient use of instructional time. Despite increasing recognition of the need for high-quality instruction in Türkiye, there is a lack of data on how often and in what ways teachers interact with children during instruction, especially in commonly used whole-group settings. To fill this gap, this preliminary exploratory study measured teachers’ instructional interaction behaviors during whole-group instruction in kindergarten classrooms. A structured observation form was used to record opportunities to respond (OTRs)—teacher prompts aimed at eliciting verbal or non-verbal student responses—and instances of positive and negative teacher feedback. Interviews with teachers were then conducted to gain deeper insights into the recorded data from two kindergarten classrooms. title: Evaluating Human Reviewers versus Artificial Intelligence: A Comparative Analysis of AI-Generated Essay Detection in Higher Education
text_snippet: Evaluating Human Reviewers versus Artificial Intelligence: A Comparative Analysis of AI-Generated Essay Detection in Higher Education The proliferation of AI text generation tools in educational settings has created unprecedented challenges for academic integrity. As AI-generated content grows more sophisticated, traditional assessment methods may no longer suffice to distinguish human from machine-authored work. This mixed-methods study compared human reviewers, an AI scoring model, and plagiarism detection tools in identifying AI-generated essays. Sixteen essays were analyzed: eight by ELT master's students and eight AI-generated (ChatGPT 4o, Gemini 1.5, Llama), with four subsequently humanized. ELT was selected because writing proficiency and authentic voice are central disciplinary competencies. Two faculty reviewers, iThenticate, Turnitin, and a GPT-4o model evaluated all essays using an expert-reviewed analytic rubric covering coherence, originality, depth, writing style, and topic adherence. The AI model showed superior internal consistency (α = 0.923) versus human reviewers (α = 0.832). Turnitin achieved the highest accuracy (87.5%). title: Curriculum Literacy, Curriculum Autonomy, and Curriculum Fidelity Among Geography Teachers: A Mixed-Methods Study
text_snippet: Curriculum Literacy, Curriculum Autonomy, and Curriculum Fidelity Among Geography Teachers: A Mixed-Methods Study In this study, the effects of geography teachers’ curriculum literacy and curriculum autonomy levels on their levels of fidelity to the curriculum have been investigated. The study was conducted using an explanatory sequential design, a mixed-methods research approach. A total of 416 geography teachers selected via simple random sampling for the quantitative component and 10 geography teachers selected via purposive sampling for the qualitative component participated in the study. Quantitative data were collected using scales measuring curriculum literacy, curriculum autonomy, and fidelity to the curriculum; qualitative data were collected through semi-structured interviews. The data were analyzed using descriptive statistical techniques, correlation and multiple linear regression analysis, and content analysis. Quantitative findings indicated that teachers’ levels of curriculum literacy, curriculum autonomy, and fidelity to the curriculum were generally high. title: Teaching and Developing Cognitive Strategies with the Gradual Release of Responsibility Model
text_snippet: Teaching and Developing Cognitive Strategies with the Gradual Release of Responsibility Model Cognitive strategy teaching is conducted using the Gradual Release of Responsibility Model in Turkish language lessons. This study aims to explore teachers' implementation of the Gradual Release of Responsibility Model in their lessons, their perspectives on the model, and the textbook activities included within this framework. To achieve this, a case study was conducted. Activities related to the graded teaching model in textbooks were examined; the application of the model by 10 Turkish language teachers was observed by the researcher; and the teachers' opinions about the model were collected. The data were analyzed through content analysis. Teaching writing skills and cognitive strategies is targeted in Turkish language textbooks within the scope of the gradual release of responsibility model. Teachers indicated that the similarity and abundance of activities in the textbooks made implementation time-consuming and negatively affected student motivation. It was also observed that teachers faced challenges in implementing the model due to factors such as large class sizes, physical conditions, and students' readiness.

title: Can Art Studio Courses Be Carried Out Online?
text_snippet: Can Art Studio Courses Be Carried Out Online? This study aimed to explore preservice teachers’ opinions regarding face-to-face and online studio courses during the COVID-19 pandemic. In this study basic qualitative research design was used. The research participants included 12 pre-service teachers studying in the department of art teacher education of the education faculty at a university located in Türkiye. The study data were collected through an interview form consisting of open-ended questions, and these data were analyzed through inductive content analysis. It was also determined a majority of preservice teachers preferred face-to-face education for studio courses. title: Examining Reasonable Accommodations Agreements in Higher Education: A Document Analysis of Disability Support Units in Türkiye
text_snippet: Examining Reasonable Accommodations Agreements in Higher Education: A Document Analysis of Disability Support Units in Türkiye Students with special needs should be able to benefit from accessible and rich learning opportunities, like their typically developing peers. The primary purpose of this study is to examine the sections and subheadings within the reasonable accommodation agreements (a written document serving as a mutual agreement prepared by the student with special needs, the faculty members responsible for the student's courses, the administration of the department where the student is enrolled, and the coordinator of the Disabled Student Unit) found on the websites of Disability Support Units (DSU) at state and private universities in Türkiye. In this research, document analysis, one of the qualitative research methods, was employed. The reasonable accommodation agreements from 53 universities (37 state and 16 private) that provide options for students with special needs on their DSU websites were analyzed through content analysis. These agreements were categorized into three main themes: "in-class accommodations," "exam accommodations," and "other accommodation requests”. title: Path Analysis of Foreign Language Enjoyment, Self-Efficacy, Learner Autonomy, And Test Anxiety
text_snippet: Path Analysis of Foreign Language Enjoyment, Self-Efficacy, Learner Autonomy, And Test Anxiety The purpose of this study is to investigate the relationships among foreign language enjoyment, self-efficacy, learner autonomy, and test anxiety in the context of learning English as a foreign language at the tertiary level. The study adopted a quantitative design, and the data were collected through the Foreign Language Enjoyment Scale, the Westside Test Anxiety Scale, the Learner Autonomy Scale, and the Self-Efficacy Beliefs Scale. The participants of the study included 385 students who were enrolled in the preparatory program of an English-medium state university. The data were analyzed using the AMOS 23 and SPSS 23 package programs. Path analysis was performed to analyze the relationships among foreign language enjoyment, self-efficacy, learner autonomy, and test anxiety. The results indicated that foreign language enjoyment positively predicted self-efficacy and learner autonomy, and learner autonomy positively predicted self-efficacy. While learner autonomy was a negative predictor of test anxiety, test anxiety was not a significant negative predictor of self-efficacy, and foreign language enjoyment was not a significant negative predictor of test anxiety. title: The Mediating Role of Instagram Addiction in the Relationship between Fear of Missing Out and Phubbing
text_snippet: The Mediating Role of Instagram Addiction in the Relationship between Fear of Missing Out and Phubbing This study investigates the mediating role of Instagram addiction in the relationship between Fear of Missing Out (FoMO) and phubbing. Findings reveal a significant positive relationship between FoMO, phubbing, and Instagram addiction. FoMO has a direct effect on both phubbing and Instagram addiction, while Instagram addiction directly affects phubbing. Furthermore, Instagram addiction was found to mediate the relationship between FoMO and phubbing through both full and partial mediation models. The results align with previous research, demonstrating that individuals with higher FoMO are more likely to engage in problematic social media use, leading to increased phubbing behavior. The study's findings offer insights into the psychological mechanisms underlying phubbing and suggest that addressing FoMO and social media addiction in psychological counseling could reduce phubbing behaviors. Future research could employ longitudinal methods to deepen the understanding of these relationships. Limitations include the self-report nature of the data and the predominantly female sample, which may affect the generalizability of the results.

title: An Investigation into Teachers' Awareness and Utilisation Levels of Digital Technologies in the Digital Transformation Process
text_snippet: An Investigation into Teachers' Awareness and Utilisation Levels of Digital Technologies in the Digital Transformation Process The primary aim of this study is to determine the extent to which teachers utilise digital transformation in educational settings. Within the scope of the study, the "Digital Transformation Utilisation Level Scale" was first developed and subsequently applied in the field. A survey design, one of the quantitative research approaches, was adopted for this study. The participantsfor the study consisted of 316 public high school teachers working in Kars province during the 2023–2024 academic year. In the sampling process, stratified sampling was used first, followed by simple random sampling. T-tests, ANOVA, Kruskal-Wallis H and Mann-Whitney U tests were applied in the analyses. The results of the analyses revealed that teachers' levels of utilisation of digital transformation were high. However, teachers demonstrated a moderate level of participation in the "Advanced Level of Digital Technology Use" sub-dimension. title: The Impact of Traditional (Face-to-Face) and Web-Based Cognitive Behavioral Psychoeducation Programs on Cyber Victimization
text_snippet: The Impact of Traditional (Face-to-Face) and Web-Based Cognitive Behavioral Psychoeducation Programs on Cyber Victimization This study aims to evaluate the effectiveness of two Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)-informed psychoeducation programs, titled "I am in Control in the Cyber World," delivered via traditional (face-to-face) and web-based modalities on adolescent cyber victimization levels. Utilizing a 4×3 mixed-factorial experimental design, 44 students in the 9th and 10th grades were randomly assigned to four conditions: traditional intervention, web-based intervention, placebo, and control groups. Data were collected using the Cyberbullying Vulnerability Scale (CVS). Results indicated that both the traditional and web-based psychoeducation programs led to a statistically significant reduction in cyber victimization compared to the control and placebo groups (p<.001, ηp² =.662). No significant differences were found between the two active intervention groups at post-test or follow-up, suggesting that both modalities maintained long-term efficacy. These findings demonstrate that CBT-based interventions, whether delivered traditionally or digitally, provide robust frameworks for mitigating cyber victimization and enhancing psychological resilience in the digital age. title: Stakeholder Voices on the Educational Status of Students Exposed to Seasonal Migration
text_snippet: Stakeholder Voices on the Educational Status of Students Exposed to Seasonal Migration This study aims to examine the educational status of primary and secondary school students from families exposed to seasonal agricultural worker migration, based on stakeholder opinions. This study, which addresses seasonal agricultural worker migration, a social issue worldwide and in Türkiye, and the educational deprivation experienced by the children of these families, is a qualitative case study based on qualitative research methods. The study group consisted of eight elementary school students, eight middle school students, six parents, eight elementary school classroom teachers, and eight middle school branch teachers from the school currently attended by the children. All the participants were from the region where the first author of this study works and had been forced to migrate seasonally on a regular basis in previous years. The data were collected through semi-structured interview forms and analyzed through thematic analysis. title: Critical Advertising Production Using Digital Technologies in Social Studies: A Media Literacy Study
text_snippet: Critical Advertising Production Using Digital Technologies in Social Studies: A Media Literacy Study The aim of this study is to enable social studies teacher candidates to design and develop critical advertisements using digital technologies by applying the knowledge and skills they acquired in the Media Literacy and Education course. In this context, the research was conducted as a design-based study, and a total of 33 social studies teacher candidates participated. Documents and video recordings of the critical advertisements developed by the participants throughout the process were systematically collected and categorized. Descriptive analysis was employed for data analysis. According to the findings, all participants produced a critical advertisement using their media literacy skills. It was determined that the elements integrated into the produced advertisements included the advertisement title, the social studies course learning outcome, the myth contained in the advertisement, the advertisement slogan, and the social media platform where the advertisement was shared. title: Personality Traits of School Administrators: A Mixed-Methods Study
text_snippet: Personality Traits of School Administrators: A Mixed-Methods Study The purpose of this study is to examine teachers’ views on the personality traits of school principals. To this end, the concurrent triangulation design (Simultaneous mixed pattern) among mixed methods designs was used in the research. The sample was determined using simple random and maximum diversity sampling methods. The sample consisted of 430 teachers working in the public sector in the Karaköprü district of Şanlıurfa province in 2023-2024 who took the “Adjective-Based Personality Test.” The participants were 20 volunteer teachers, 14 women and 6 men, who were interviewed using a semi-structured interview form. Content analysis was used to analyze the qualitative data, and descriptive statistics were used to determine the level of teachers’ perceptions. The results of the study revealed that school administrators reacted excessively harshly, encountered positive and negative situations due to their leniency caused such situations, communicated and interacted with stakeholders in terms of extroversion, and prioritized discipline and rules in the context of responsibility. title: Investigation of Elementary Mathematics Teacher Candidates' Representational Fluency Levels in Number Sets
text_snippet: Investigation of Elementary Mathematics Teacher Candidates' Representational Fluency Levels in Number Sets The aim of this study is to investigate the representational fluency levels of pre-service elementary mathematics teachers in number sets in the context of verbal, model and mathematical language representations. The survey model was adopted, and open-ended questions were used as data collection tools. The prepared questions were designed to express the number sets including natural, counting, whole, rational, irrational and real numbers with verbal, model and mathematical language representation types. The sample of the study consisted of 39 female and 14 male students studying in the first year of the elementary mathematics teaching programme of a university. The findings revealed that the pre-service teachers were successful in counting and natural number sets, but they had more difficulties with integers, irrational numbers and real numbers. It was also found that the pre-service teachers were generally successful in verbal representation skills, but had difficulties in mathematical language representations. title: A Socioscientific Perspective in Education: Evaluation of the Informal Reasoning Processes of Science and Art Center Students on “Carbon Footprint”
text_snippet: A Socioscientific Perspective in Education: Evaluation of the Informal Reasoning Processes of Science and Art Center Students on “Carbon Footprint” Informal reasoning encompasses the processes by which individuals develop arguments, generate counterarguments, and justify their claims by evaluating different perspectives on complex issues that do not have a single correct answer. The aim of this study is to evaluate the informal reasoning processes of students who are gifted in the field of physics at the Science and Art Center regarding the socioscientific issue of carbon footprint. In the study, the informal reasoning modes developed by the students on issues related to carbon footprint, such as energy, transportation, food, water, and waste, and the quality of these reasoning processes were analyzed. The 71 ninth-grade students who participated in the study completed the Environmental Education and Climate Change course. The data were collected using the “Informal Reasoning Form on Socioscientific Issues,” and the “Opinion Form,” and the responses given to open-ended questions related to the scenarios were examined. title: Türkçe Klinik Okuma Değerlendirmesi için R Tabanlı Nicel Hesaplamalı Metin Analizi Aracı
text_snippet: Türkçe Klinik Okuma Değerlendirmesi için R Tabanlı Nicel Hesaplamalı Metin Analizi Aracı Bu çalışma, okuma becerilerinin klinik değerlendirmesinde kullanılan metinlerin nicel dilbilimsel özelliklerini değerlendirmek üzere R programlama dili temelli bilgisayar destekli bir metin analiz aracı geliştirmek ve bu araçla yeni oluşturulan metinleri test etmeyi amaçlamaktadır. Bu bağlamda, araştırmacılar tarafından anlatı metni “Çifte Sürpriz” ve bilgilendirici metin “Deniz Yıldızları”, dilbilimsel ve yapısal karmaşıklık açısından üç farklı düzeyde yazılmıştır. M2a ve M2b metinlerinin, dilbilimsel parametreler açısından birbirine en yakın metinler olduğu belirlenmiştir. title: The Effect of Interactionist versus Interventionist Dynamic Assessment on Metadiscourse Markers in Turkish EFL Students’ Argumentative Essays
text_snippet: The Effect of Interactionist versus Interventionist Dynamic Assessment on Metadiscourse Markers in Turkish EFL Students’ Argumentative Essays This multiple case study investigates whether interactionist or interventionist dynamic assessment (DA) produces different effects on ELT students’ use of metadiscourse markers in argumentative essays. 10 first-year ELT students at a state university in Turkey participated and were randomly assigned to interactionist (n=5) and interventionist (n=5) DA groups. Data were collected through individual mediation sessions, and participants’ use of metadiscourse markers in both their first and second drafts was analyzed according to Hyland’s (2005) metadiscourse framework. A qualitative content analysis using NVivo 12 examined error types, metadiscourse marker categories, responsiveness to mediation, and participants’ perceptions of DA sessions. Findings indicate that both interactionist and interventionist DA positively influenced learners’ use of metadiscourse markers, though interactionist DA yielded slightly greater improvements in error correction and autonomous problem-solving. Participants reported increased awareness of punctuation, transition markers, and the syntactic placement of metadiscourse markers, and valued the implicit, dialogue-based nature of mediation. title: Öğretmenlerin Mesleki Gelişime Yönelik Tutumlarının Psikolojik Çıktıları Üzerindeki Etkisine Yönelik Yapısal Bir Model

title: Why Does Academic Fatigue Occur in Universities? Academic Fatigue Scale Development Study
text_snippet: Why Does Academic Fatigue Occur in Universities? Academic Fatigue Scale Development Study among university faculty members in Türkiye. The present study seeks to construct and validate a robust measurement scale capturing the multidimensional nature of academic fatigue among academics or teachers. After constructing a preliminary item pool, the proposed scale was administered to 443 academics across Turkish higher education institutions to assess its factorial validity and reliability. First, a pilot study was conducted on the research data. The items were simplified, and exploratory and confirmatory factor analysis were performed. Construct, convergent, and discriminant validity and reliability tests were also performed on the data. The Academic Fatigue Scale consists of three subdimensions: Structural Problem Areas, Functional Problem Areas, and Managerial Problem Areas, with 28 statements. The study results demonstrate that the Academic Fatigue Scale is a measurement tool with high internal consistency, reliability, and construct validity, assessing academics’ or individuals’ perceptions of academic fatigue in the education profession.

Noktalama işaretleri başarı testinin ön test uygulamasında deney ve kontrol grupları arasında fark bulunmamıştır. Deney grubunda yer alan öğrencilere yedi hafta boyunca farklı noktalama işaretleri dijital hikâye aracılığıyla anlatılmış ve noktalama işaretlerine yönelik hazırlanan dijital etkinlikler kullanılmıştır. title: An Analysis of Rater Behaviors in The Music Special Ability Selection Examination
text_snippet: An Analysis of Rater Behaviors in The Music Special Ability Selection Examination The purpose of this study is to identify the rating behaviors of raters involved in the music special talent admission examination. The study group consists of two subgroups: candidates and raters. The candidate group comprises 114 individuals who took the special talent entrance examination for admission to the music education department of a public university, while the rater group consists of five raters who evaluated the candidates’ performances. A fully crossed design was employed, and the data were analyzed using the Many-Facet Rasch Model. Within this framework, several rater behaviors were examined, including severity, leniency, central tendency, halo effect, rater × candidate bias, and rater × candidate gender bias. The findings indicated that, at the group level, halo effect, rater × candidate bias, and rater × candidate gender bias were not present; however, severity, leniency, and central tendency behaviors did emerge. At the individual level, one rater exhibited severity, all raters demonstrated central tendency, and one rater showed a halo effect. title: Bir Matematik Öğretmeni Adayının Teknoloji Destekli Matematiksel Modellemedeki Bilgi İşlemsel Düşünme Eylemleri
text_snippet: Bir Matematik Öğretmeni Adayının Teknoloji Destekli Matematiksel Modellemedeki Bilgi İşlemsel Düşünme Eylemleri Bu çalışmanın amacı, bir matematik öğretmeni adayının teknoloji destekli matematiksel modellemedeki bilgi işlemsel düşünme temelli zihinsel eylemlerinin incelenmesidir. Çalışma, nitel araştırma yöntemlerinden durum çalışması ile yürütülmüştür. Çalışmada katılımcı ölçüt örnekleme yöntemi ile seçilmiştir. Veriler matematik öğretmeni adayının "Dönme Dolap Problemi"ne yönelik çözüm sürecini açıklayan video çözümlemeleri, ekran görüntüleri, yazılı yanıt kağıtları ve GeoGebra dosyalarından derlenmiştir. Teknoloji destekli matematiksel modellemenin tüm temel basamaklarında bilgi işlemsel düşünmeye yönelik zihinsel eylemlere rastlanmıştır. Bu becerilerin hangi matematiksel modelleme basamaklarında ne yoğunlukta ortaya çıktığı bulgularda sunulmuştur.

title: Using Temporal Information to Construct Situation Models of Narratives
text_snippet: Using Temporal Information to Construct Situation Models of Narratives The ultimate goal of the act of reading is to understand the text and gain knowledge. For this purpose, the cognitive system creates a two-dimensional mental representation of the event situations in the text during the reading process, namely, the text base and the situation model. The text base is the aggregation of words forming propositional structures; the structuring of the relations between propositions form the macro-text structure. However, text-based mental representations are not sufficient to understand the text; therefore, creating mental representations of the temporal and spatial location of event situations in the text and the situation model is necessary to provide information about the text entities. In this sense, situation models are mental processors that enable the integration of the mental representation of the web of relationships comprising the text with the readers’ world knowledge. title: Ders İmecesi Yöntemiyle Yürütülen STEM Eğitim Sürecinin İncelenmesi: Bir Durum Çalışması
text_snippet: Ders İmecesi Yöntemiyle Yürütülen STEM Eğitim Sürecinin İncelenmesi: Bir Durum Çalışması Çağdaş eğitim yaklaşımlarından olan STEM eğitiminin ders imecesi (lesson study) yönteminden yaralanarak kullanılması ders içeriklerinin geliştirilme sürecinin iyileştirilmesine katkı sağlayabilir. Ders imecesi ile öğretmenler, küçük gruplara yönelik gözlem ve analiz yaparak nitelikli ders planlamaları gerçekleştirilebilir. Bu çalışmada, gerçek sınıf ortamında uygulanan STEM eğitim yaklaşımı ile öğrencilerin karşılaştıkları yaşam problemlerini çözme sürecinde sergiledikleri performanslarının ortak bakış açısıyla değerlendirilmesi hedeflenmektedir. Bu sebeple, ders imecesi yöntemi kullanılarak uygulanan STEM eğitim sürecinin incelenmesi için nitel araştırma kapsamında bütüncül tek durum deseni kullanılmıştır. Katılımcılar, bir devlet üniversitesinin Eğitim Fakültesi, Temel Eğitim Bölümü, Sınıf Eğitim Ana bilim Dalı’nda öğrenim gören sekiz dördüncü sınıf öğretmeni adayıdır. Çalışma devlet okulunda Öğretmenlik Uygulaması- II dersi kapsamında yürütmüş olup gerekli etik ve uygulama izinleri alınmıştır. title: Nöroeğitim Çalışmalarına Kapsamlı Bir Bakış
text_snippet: Nöroeğitim Çalışmalarına Kapsamlı Bir Bakış Bu çalışmanın amacı nöroeğitim çalışmalarının mevcut durumunu ortaya koymak ve araştırmaların yönelimini belirlemektir. Bu doğrultuda incelenen çalışmaların yazar sayısı, yayın yılı, araştırmacıların ülkeleri, indeks, dergi alanı, örneklem grubu, örneklem büyüklüğü, örnekleme yöntemi, konu alanı, yöntem, veri toplama araçları, veri analiz yöntemi, araştırmanın amaçı, sonuç ve öneri dağılımları tümdengelim ve tümevarım içerik analizi kullanılarak incelenmiştir. Çalışma kapsamında incelenen çalışmalar Web of Science, ERIC ve H. W. Wilson veri tabanlarından elde edilmiştir. Çalışmalar ön değerlendirmeden geçirilerek belirlenen ölçütler doğrultusunda toplam 208 araştırma çalışma kapsamına dahil edilmiştir. Analiz sonuçlarına göre, çalışmaların çoğunluk ile eğitim alanındaki dergilerde yayımlandığı, veri tabanlarından WoS tercih edildiği, çalışmaların genellikle tek yazarlı olduğu ve araştırmacıların büyük çoğunluğunun Amerika Birleşik Devletleri’nden olduğu belirlenmiştir. Kuramsal düzeydeki çalışmaların daha fazla tercih edildiği, veri toplama aracı olacak nitel yöntemlerin ve veri analiz yöntemlerinden ise nicel yöntemlerin seçildiği belirlenmiştir. title: Üniversite Öğrencilerinde Olumlu Çocukluk Yaşantıları ile Kariyer Yapılandırma Arasındaki İlişkide Umudun Aracı Rolü
text_snippet: Üniversite Öğrencilerinde Olumlu Çocukluk Yaşantıları ile Kariyer Yapılandırma Arasındaki İlişkide Umudun Aracı Rolü Olumlu çocukluk yaşantılarının yetişkin sağlığı üzerindeki etkileri literatürde kendine yer bulmuştur. Ancak bu yaşantıların kariyer gelişimi ile ilişkisini konu alan araştırmalar sınırlıdır. Bu çalışmanın amacı, üniversite öğrencilerinde olumlu çocukluk yaşantıları ile kariyer yapılandırma arasındaki ilişkide umudun aracı rolünü incelemektir. Araştırmada ilişkisel tarama modeli kullanılmıştır. Araştırmanın çalışma grubunu uygun örnekleme yöntemi ile seçilen 437'si kadın ve 120'si erkek olmak üzere toplam 557 üniversite öğrencisi oluşturmaktadır. Veri toplama sürecinde Kişisel Bilgi Formu, Olumlu Çocukluk Yaşantıları Ölçeği, Sürekli Umut Ölçeği ve Öğrenci Kariyer Yapılandırma Envanteri kullanılmıştır. Verilerin analizinde betimsel istatistikler, korelasyon analizi, doğrulayıcı faktör analizi ve güvenilirlik analizi kullanılmıştır. Aracılık analizi için Hayes'in 4. Modeli ve Bootstrapping yöntemi kullanılmıştır. Analiz sonucunda olumlu çocukluk yaşantıları ile kariyer yapılandırma ve umut arasında pozitif yönde anlamlı ilişkiler bulunmuştur. title: İlköğretim Matematik Öğretmeni Adaylarına Yönelik Matematik Dilinin Öğretimi Öz Yeterlik Ölçeğinin Geliştirilmesi
text_snippet: İlköğretim Matematik Öğretmeni Adaylarına Yönelik Matematik Dilinin Öğretimi Öz Yeterlik Ölçeğinin Geliştirilmesi Bu araştırmada ilköğretim matematik öğretmeni adaylarının matematik dilini öğretmeye ilişkin öz yeterliklerini belirlemek için bir ölçeğin geliştirilmesi amaçlanmıştır. Araştırmanın katılımcılarını 14 üniversitenin ilgili programının son yarıyılında öğrenim gören 419 öğretmen adayı oluşturmaktadır. Ölçeğin ne düzeyde geçerli ve güvenilir ölçme gerçekleştirdiği madde uyum istatistikleri, benimsenen kategori yapısının işlevselliği, kişilere ve maddelere yönelik güvenirlik ve ayırt edicilik indeksleri, örneklemi hedefleme yeterliği, maddelerin oluşturduğu hiyerarşi, maddelerin yanlılık gösterme durumu, tek boyutluluk ve yerel bağımsızlık bileşenleri açısından incelenmiştir. Verilerin analizi, Rasch ölçme teorisi çerçevesinde derecelendirme ölçeği modeli temelinde Winsteps® yazılımı aracılığıyla gerçekleştirilmiştir. title: Yüz Yüze Eğitim Süresi ve Akademik Tükenmişlik Arasındaki İlişkide, Algılanan Sosyal Destek ve Sosyal İlişki Gereksiniminin Aracı Rolü
